 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 25, 2026, 16:45 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print A matter you have carried for weeks reaches its peak. The Full Moon falls in Taurus, your 1st house of self, body and first impressions, opposite the Sun in Scorpio in your 7th house of partnerships. Mercury retrograde in Scorpio sits there too, so agreements get a second look. What you want and what another person wants now sit side by side. Name your part, then let the rest go. Taurus Career Predictions
 A project, a role or a talk with a partner or client may reach a clear result. Review what was agreed against the earlier email before you respond. A senior could notice your steadier tone. Let finished work do the speaking. Someone may press for a quick yes. Take a day, and confirm the final terms in writing. Taurus Love Predictions
 Feelings are strong, and a partner may feel them too. Say what you need in one plain sentence, then listen to the reply. Couples can close an old argument by agreeing not to reopen it. Singles may feel ready to leave a past attachment behind. Reply to no one in a hurry. Clarity arrives by evening. Taurus Money Predictions
 Personal spending may feel loud tomorrow, like a treat, a grooming plan, or a gadget bought to match the mood. Check your balance first. A joint cost or a client balance may return with a changed figure, so ask for the breakdown. Hold new credit and large buys until Mercury moves direct. Taurus Health Predictions
 Energy peaks, and so does tension in the throat, neck and jaw. Sleep may run light around the Full Moon. Keep dinner early and plain. Sip warm water. And let the evening stay quiet, since a bright mood still needs rest. Taurus Remedies
 Write one thing you are ready to finish and one you will keep. Switch off bright screens an hour before sleep.
